messages:
ivy: hey all, day 1 question - where's the single source of truth for onboarding docs & templates in Notion? I see a few pages but not sure which one to duplicate from
samir: welcome ivy! canonical templates live in Company Home > DevEx > Templates Library. we lock the library so only the 'Redwood - Docs Editors' group can duplicate/edit
ivy: I can view but Duplicate is greyed out. I clicked Request edit access but nothing popped up
lina: sometimes the Okta sync lags. two quick fixes: 1) post the page link here and we can add you manually, or 2) file an access request in the HR onboarding form. devex-bot also watches that queue
ivy: posting: https://notion.fake/redwood/templates/onboarding-2026
devex-bot: devex-bot received request to add ivy to 'Redwood - Docs Editors' (okta)
samir: added you manually. you should get a Notion invite in a minute
ops-bot: ops-bot added ivy to "Redwood - Docs Editors" (okta)
ivy: got it, can duplicate now :tada: a follow-up - when I make a runbook from the template, which workspace should it live in so search works? team page or Company Docs?
lina: prefer Company Home > Teams > <Your Team> for team-facing docs. add the page to the Docs Index DB (use 'Add to index') and set Owner + Tags. if it's infra-critical, put it under DevEx > Runbooks and add the #rb tag
samir: quick copy-paste checklist we ask new page creators to follow:
```
- Title: <Team> - Short title
- Owner: @your-name
- Summary: one-line description
- Tags: #runbook #infra #product (as appropriate)
- Visibility: Team or Company
- Index: Add to Docs Index DB and set Parent team
- Permissions: Editors = Redwood - Docs Editors; Viewers = Everyone at Redwood
```
ivy: perfect. one subtlety: can templates be edited? I have a small improvement suggestion to the meeting notes template
lina: don't edit the canonical template directly. open a short note in Templates Feedback (Company Home > DevEx > Templates Feedback) with your suggestion and link an example. devex will update the canonical if the change is approved
ivy: will do. thanks everyone for the speedy help :pray:
thread_text_summary: New hire asks where canonical Notion templates live; devex explains Templates Library permissions and Docs Editors group; Okta/manual add flow used to enable Duplicate; checklist for new pages and index rules; guidance to propose template changes via Templates Feedback.
